scope_note: Clause-level traceability only for the clauses this phase actually implements. The 61-section registry remains section-level and is not a decomposition of the whole specification.

clauses.clause: A research asset carries a stable identity, type, version, lineage and time semantics.
clauses.gap: Portfolio and order objects do not exist.

clauses.clause: Every cited evidence id on an object must resolve in the evidence store.
A factual statement in a research artefact resolves to stored evidence with the same issuer, period, unit, currency and value.
clauses.gap: Verification covers SEC XBRL facts and model outputs, not narrative text.

clauses.clause: A derived metric is recomputed independently from its recorded inputs and operator version.
clauses.gap: Only the ratio and cash-flow formulas in FORMULAS are recomputed.

clauses.clause: An analyst assumption or hypothesis is never presented as an observed fact.
Evidence, computational, statistical and decision integrity are reported separately without a single trust score.
clauses.gap: Statistical integrity has no empirical test to run; it reports not_applicable.

clauses.clause: A report states its coverage, cutoff, source rights and missing inputs rather than implying completeness.
A professional artefact exports without silently inserting newer evidence or changing a number.
clauses.gap: No PDF renderer; no spreadsheet or notebook import.

clauses.clause: The analyst can export a professional artefact from a saved research workspace.
clauses.gap: The export is Markdown/HTML/JSON; no PDF; the workspace link is recorded but not enforced as a foreign key.

clauses.clause: A saved artefact is monitored for source changes without rewriting it.
clauses.gap: On-demand only; no scheduler, notification delivery or automatic re-run.

clauses.clause: ICB-39 and ICB-48 gain verified prerequisites without being accepted.
clauses.gap: No independent analyst baseline; ICB-48 remains vision_only.

clauses.clause: Narrative evidence retrieval with grounded spans and abstention.
clauses.gap: No chunking, index, retriever or grounded-QA evaluation; contract only in docs/RESEARCH_AND_COMPRESSION_INTEGRATION.md.
